labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a wider type annotation on Table.title, which is new behaviour rather than a defect.

items.body:
Rich asks for feature requests to be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start a discussion there describing the change to `Table.title`. The parameter is typed as `TextType`, which is `Union[str, Text]` in [rich/text.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/text.py). A closely related earlier issue, #4171, has the same title and was closed as not planned, so please read it before starting the discussion.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
